item.title: Performance
item.description:
Native (engine v0.1.0)

Measured on an Apple M4 Max, one core, median of 3. The benchmarks are committed in the engine repository.

Benchmark What Result
pull from a layout cold pull of the hello image (735 kB tar+gzip layer): verify and store 1.26 ms
unpack a gzip layer apply that layer to an empty tree 11.5 ms
copy-on-write clone a container’s root plus its first write 2.2 µs
cold start first container of an image: wazero compiles the module and runs it to exit 610 ms
warm start every later container: compiled module from the per-digest cache 3.4 ms

These native numbers were measured without a reference runtime on the machine.

In the browser (the playground)

One run on a CI ubuntu-latest runner, in Chromium and Firefox, with the native wazero and wasmtime 50 on the same runner for comparison:

What Chromium Firefox wazero native wasmtime 50
page ready 0.46 s 1.0 s
first run of hello 81 ms 291 ms 825 ms 23 ms
next run 47 ms 231 ms 5.4 ms
one WASI call 97 µs 354 µs

Page ready is slower with the dashboard. On the live site in Chromium the page was ready in 728 ms for the terminal page and 1070 ms for the dashboard (the new default UI). dashboard.wasm is 20.45 MB raw and 5.32 MB gzipped; a size reduction of go-widgets is in progress (planned).

Cold start in the browser is slower than wasmtime (81 ms against 23 ms in Chromium, 291 ms in Firefox). These are single runs on one CI machine, not medians, so they show orders of magnitude rather than precise ratios.
